tips.text: Collect the medallions from the daily alerts, play until your affinity standing is capped, then turn them in; they ignore the cap.
Cap the day fast in Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, leaving around round 8, or in the Duviri Circuit up to about stage 4.
Run an Affinity Booster; it doubles your standing gain.
Fill the cap in one run with an Equinox or Ivara sleep plus a big melee weapon on Adaro, Sedna Exterminate.
Have the Aya ready before you reach Protector and rank up at once; standing past a rank's maximum is wasted while you wait.
Spend your standing or rank up before a long Duviri or Circuit run; with your pledged bar full, the loss to opposed syndicates can reach 70k to 200k.
Max Arbiters of Hexis or Cephalon Suda first if you want several syndicates, then pledge Steel Meridian for good; it feeds Red Veil and leaves both alone.
Plan the standing for the other Vaykor weapons too; they use the same General rank and give separate Mastery.
Players call the Steel Meridian climb one of the easiest syndicate grinds, about two weeks with the alerts every day.
